jobs.title: Normandy SR-2 — baie des navettes (ME3)
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one complete environment master for a high-definition 2D fighting game set in Mass Effect 3. Create a landscape widescreen 16:9 stage background of the Normandy SR-2 shuttle bay, Alliance refit in ME3, closely following the attached actual in-game screenshot as the visual reference for geometry, material palette, ceiling construction and lighting. Preserve the recognizable dark industrial shuttle bay, charcoal floor panels and inset tracks, pale structural columns, layered overhead ribbed beams, dense ceiling conduits, overhead cool white fluorescent strips, rows of utilitarian crates at the left, the angular blue-gray Kodiak shuttle at the right wall, the amber/orange holographic armory and workbench displays flanking the center, and the broad reinforced bulkhead at the back. Keep the restrained cool gray-blue lighting with small warm amber monitor accents. Reframe as a panoramic fighting stage viewed from the entrance across the broad level metal floor, with a clean continuous horizontal combat lane across the lower quarter. Shallow perspective, a stable level horizon, all central floor space clear. Remove the player figure and all crew, leaving only the architecture, vehicles and equipment. Make a new polished detailed game background, keeping the reference identities and layout closely; no change to an elegant Cerberus white interior or the SR-1. No characters, no HUD, no captions, no title, no watermark, no contact sheet, one scene only. Avoid alien hangar inventions, space exterior openings, giant added windows, excessive bloom, red emergency lighting or cargo obstructing the fight lane.

jobs.title: Sur’Kesh — plateforme de la base GSI (ME3)
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one complete environment master for a high-definition 2D fighting game set in Mass Effect 3. Create a landscape widescreen 16:9 side-on stage at the salarian STG research facility on Sur'Kesh during the Priority: Sur'Kesh mission, before major destruction. Use the three attached actual game screenshots as references: image 1 fixes the distant steep densely forested karst cliffs, tiered cream-beige salarian research structures built into cliffs and narrow white waterfalls descending into mist; image 2 fixes the landing terrace's warm gray-brown metallic floor panels, low segmented pale guardrails and square recessed laboratory entrance; image 3 fixes the facility's pale angled structural supports, muted teal inlaid trim and tropical planted alcoves. Compose a faithful visual adaptation of the landing-platform environment for a 2D duel: a continuous flat horizontal metallic combat floor across the bottom quarter with low foreground edge, the small recessed laboratory entrance at the left background, low terrace guardrails behind the fight lane, and the dense forest cliffs, stepped facility buildings and waterfalls visible beyond. Preserve the recognizable angular layered salarian architecture and muted humid olive-green, cream, brown and teal palette of the references. Soft daylight through humid haze, detailed realistic game environment painting, clean readable floor. Empty scene: no fighters, no NPCs, no Atlas, no pod, no weapon effects, no HUD, no labels, no watermarks, no title, no contact sheet. Do not substitute the Firebase Jade multiplayer layout or a generic jungle temple. Keep the stage on a platform within the STG facility with the documented cliffscape beyond; do not invent alien domes, neon purple foliage or colossal city towers. One cohesive complete background only.
